2610.11546.title: Learning to Orchestrate Evolutionary Search: Progression-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic DE-CMA-ES Coordination in Optimization and Structural Model Updating
2610.11546.paper_summary: Solving high-dimensional structural model updating problems requires an algorithm capable of navigating complex, non-convex landscapes with correlated parameters. Existing hybrid evolutionary algorithms typically rely on static architectures or fixed switching rules, resulting in disjointed search phases. To address this, this study proposes a Deep Reinforcement Learning-governed dynamic DE-CMAES Orchestration (DRL-DCO) algorithm, in which a Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG)-based actor-critic agent continuously governs the evolutionary process as a single, unified system rather than a mechanical concatenation of algorithms. Guided by a progression-aware state representation and a diversity-informed reward, the agent fluidly reallocates computational resources between the differencevector-based exploration of Differential Evolution (DE) and the covariance-guided exploitation of CMA-ES, while jointly regulating population size, elite preservation, and a restart mechanism to escape local optima. This allows DRL-DCO to autonomously transition between exploration-dominant, exploitation-dominant, and mixed-strategy regimes across generations. Beyond the training phase, the trained actor can operate in a supervision-free inference mode, where the internalized policy autonomously orchestrates DE and CMA-ES control from observed search states through forward inference alone, without critic evaluation or weight updates, enabling faster deployment while retaining full effectiveness. Validated on high-dimensional single-objective optimization benchmarks and the IASC-ASCE structural health monitoring benchmark, DRL-DCO achieves superior convergence accuracy and robustness compared to state-of-the-art adaptive and hybrid evolutionary algorithms, as well as single-operator DRL-governed baselines.
2610.11546.paper_summary_zh: 解決高維結構模型更新問題需要一種能夠在具有相關參數的複雜非凸地形中導航的算法。現有的混合進化算法通常依賴於靜態架構或固定的切換規則，導致搜索階段不連貫。為了解決這個問題，本研究提出了一種由深度強化學習主導的動態DE-CMAES協調算法（DRL-DCO），其中基於深度確定性策略梯度（DDPG）的演員-評論者代理持續主導進化過程，作為一個單一的統一系統，而不是算法的機械串聯。代理在進度感知的狀態表示和多樣性知情的獎勵指導下，靈活地在基於差異向量的差分進化（DE）探索和協方差引導的CMA-ES利用之間重新分配計算資源，同時共同調節種群大小、精英保留和重啟機制，以逃避局部最優。這使得DRL-DCO能夠在世代之間自主轉換探索主導、利用主導和混合策略的模式。在訓練階段之後，訓練過的演員可以在無需監督的推斷模式下運行，其中內部化的策略自主協調DE和CMA-ES控制，僅通過前向推斷從觀察到的搜索狀態進行，而無需評論評估或權重更新，從而實現更快的部署，同時保持完全的有效性。在高維單目標優化基準和IASC-ASCE結構健康監測基準上進行驗證，DRL-DCO在收斂準確性和穩健性方面超越了最先進的自適應和混合進化算法，以及單一運營商的DRL主導基準。
